newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip on long-liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip on long-liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures settled weaker across the board on Thursday, pressured by long-liquidation, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.8 yen to 1.6 yen per kilogram lower. Benchmark May was down 1.3 yen at 142.2 yen.

Despite a recent fall in rubber stocks, there was talk that stocks may rise from next year, which was considered a negative factor, they said. "Recent falls in open interest suggested the market lacked energy to rise sharply unless some strong bullish factors emerge," one trader said.
